agents.boss: Routed the stock problem to Inventory first, the overdue invoice to Accounting, and the customer update to Customer Service. Ran 3 follow-ups after approvals, then closed the ticket on a manager note once the bill was paid, the restock was ordered and the draft was ready.
agents.inventory: Confirmed CC-TEE-WHITE size S had 0 on hand (short by 1). Planned the restock: Bulldog Print Co, 5-day lead, blocked until invoice 501 was paid. Sent Accounting the money heads-up, then sized the restock at 1 unit ($8).
agents.accounting: Checked cash and the ledger. Requested payment of overdue invoice 501 ($840, approval #1). After it was paid, requested PO #1 for 1× tee S ($8, approval #2).
agents.customer_service: Asked Inventory and Accounting for facts and drafted the update to Tauhid Zaman (draft #3 kept). It contains no internal vendor or invoice details.

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
tickets.outcome: Only 8 of 20 hoodies could be supplied, and the 12-unit restock ($264) was more than the $152 left. A 20-unit quote was rejected, and a quote for the 8 in stock at $36.67 each ($293.36, 40% margin) was approved and drafted to the club.

agents.boss: Sent the fill check to Inventory first, then pricing to Accounting and the reply to Customer Service. Re-planned after the human rejected the 20-unit quote, and resolved the ticket once the 8-unit quote was approved and the final draft written.
agents.inventory: Confirmed 8 of 20 CC-HOOD-NAVY size M on hand (12 short). Planned the restock ($264 from Bulldog Print Co) and flagged that cash couldn't cover it.
agents.accounting: Found the 40%-margin price floor ($36.67/unit, 36.8% off $58) with price_for_margin and calculate_margin. Requested a quote for 20 (approval #4, rejected), then for the 8 in stock: $293.36 (approval #5, approved).
agents.customer_service: Asked Inventory and Accounting for stock and price, then wrote the final reply (draft #6): 8 hoodies at $36.67 each ($293.36), and the other 12 can't be supplied right now.

human_approvals.request: Quote 20× CC-HOOD-NAVY at $36.67 (36.8% off $58.00) = $733.40 — Yale AI Club bulk quote at the maximum discount preserving 40% gross margin (36.8% off $58 list).
human_approvals.effect_or_note: Do not quote 20. Only the 8 hoodies on hand can be delivered: the 12-unit restock costs $264 and checking has $152 with no revenue coming in. Quote just the 8 in stock at a bulk price that keeps at least 40% gross margin, and have Customer Service tell the club the other 12 cannot be supplied right now.

human_approvals.request: Quote 8× CC-HOOD-NAVY at $36.67 (36.8% off $58.00) = $293.36 — Quote only the 8 size M hoodies currently in stock after rejection of the 20-unit request; no restock. At $36.67 each, total $293.36, calculated gross margin is 40.0%.
